descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: duplicate matching across contexts and accounts.

Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S17 Duplicate matching stays inside its context and inside the physician's own list

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U4 When a day-2 scan overlaps day 1, the app shows 'N patients are already on your list' with an 'add only the new ones' option. … (UAT TC-02; TFA-92580 AC 5; TFA-92580 How it works 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U9 Runs and passes in both contexts: the Hospital capture (camera icon) and the Nursing Home 'Scan Resident List' (3.3). (UAT 3.3; TFA-92580 How it works 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Local stack. scan-probe, with scanCensusSheet mocked at the socket using the rows of the named fixtures, and seeding through e2e/support/backend.ts

When Leg 1: physician A's Hospital list holds QA Alder (401, 300101), QA Birch and QA Cedar; A scans a Nursing Home resident list holding QA Alder and QA Oak. Leg 2 (reverse): A's Nursing Home holds QA Juniper 1938-04-02 Cedar 10; A scans a Hospital list holding QA Juniper and QA Oak. …

Then No row in any leg is treated as already on the list: no 'Possible duplicate', no 'In panel' or 'Review'. Each scan adds all its rows to the scanning physician's list, in the scanning context only. The other context's list is unchanged, and the Hospital chart of QA Juniper shows no Nursing Home data such as 'Cedar 10'. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): scan-probe asserts the scan-sheet text and reads rounding:list / snf:list as each physician: counts and fields before = after for B and for the other context. Any match across contexts or across physicians is a Fail (data from another context, or another physician's patient: a PHI leak, or a real new patient dropped as 'already on your list'). …

Where it ran: local probes (multi-device probes); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S17 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane probes.

Test method: PW · Playwright script (PW (mocked scans)); secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both (legs 1-2) / local (leg 3); Source: probes.

UAT item: TC-02 Patient List Capture · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-02/S17

Duplicate matching stays inside its context and inside the physician's own list

Tickets: TFA-92580 Patient List Capture (Scan Census OCR + manual add) (rejected by qa)

New local lane probes: status passed in probes/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (probes/plan.json, automatable: yes): scan-probe, three legs (Hospital→NH, NH→Hospital, other physician), each a fresh physician; sheet text must not claim a match; per-account list reads before/after; Hospital chart of QA Juniper must not show 'Cedar 10'. — Mocked rows + own-account reads.

Detail:

Leg 1 (Hospital holds Alder; NH scan Alder+Oak): no match claim, 2 residents added, Hospital unchanged. Leg 2 (NH holds Juniper; Hospital scan Juniper+Oak): no duplicate prompt, 2 added, NH unchanged, Juniper's Hospital chart has no 'Cedar 10'. Leg 3: C gets 3 + 3, B unchanged.
